meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia - unitary national jurisdiction; commercial registry delegated to municipal Cámaras de Comercio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Continental/Neo-Romanist), with selected Anglo-Saxon corporate-law concepts introduced by Law 1258 of 2008 (S.A.S.)

Colombia-Peru-EU Multiparty Free Trade Agreement, provisional application August 2013

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 1121 of 2006 (AML/CFT framework); Law 526 of 1999 (UIAF); Law 1258 of 2008 (S.A.S. regime); Law 1778 of 2016 (FATF-aligned UBO powers); Decree 1074 of 2015, as amended by Decree 830 of 2021 (Registro de Beneficiario Final); Decree 1068 of 2015 (UAF organizational rules); Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia External Circular 004 of 2020 (SARLAFT/TFLA); Law 1762 of 2015 (AML predicate offenses); Law 2195 of 2022 (public procurement and UBO verification)
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (RBF data filed with the Cámaras de Comercio; accessible to UIAF, DIAN, Superintendencia de Sociedades, Superfinanciera, fiscal authorities and anti-corruption agencies; not publicly searchable)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Existence of the Foreign Corporate Shareholder (Certificado de Existencia equivalent)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official Companies Registry or equivalent corporate authority in the shareholder's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the home-state competent authority; consular legalization only if home state is not a Hague Convention member

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Copy of Constitutional Documents (Memorandum and Articles of Association / Bylaws) of the Foreign Corporate Shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or notary public of the jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or consular legalization if non-Hague jurisdiction)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Special Power of Attorney (Poder Especial) granted by the foreign shareholder to the Colombian incorporator or legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the shareholder's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or consular legalization if non-Hague jurisdiction)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate Resolution of the Foreign Shareholder authorizing incorporation of the Colombian S.A.S., appointment of representatives and UBO designation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate secretary and/or notary of the issuing foreign company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or consular legalization if non-Hague jurisdiction)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized UBO Declaration and passport copies of each ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the shareholder's country of origin; alternatively a Colombian notary upon personal appearance in Colombia
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if issued abroad (or consular legalization); Colombian notarial certification if executed in Colombia

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory multi-list screening for all UBOs, directors and authorized signatories: UN Security Council Consolidated Lists (1267/1989/1988), OFAC SDN and Non-SDN Lists, EU and UK consolidated financial sanctions, FATF high-risk jurisdiction identifications, and Colombian national watchlists (UIAF Listas de Riesgo-LAFT, SARLAFT PEP database under External Circular 004 of 2020). PEP categorization covers executive, legislative, judicial, military, state-owned enterprise and senior political-party roles. Enhanced due diligence is triggered by any PEP status, sanctions hit, adverse-media finding, or investor domicile in a FATF-listed jurisdiction. Screening refresh is required at onboarding, on any ownership change, and at least annually during the corporate life.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SIPRUES - Registro Único Empresarial (RUES) via Cámara de Comercio digital platforms (www.rues.org.co / www.ccb.org.co)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate name must be expressed in Latin/Spanish script; coined or mixed-language names are accepted if clearly readable and not misleading. Foreign-script documents must be translated by a Colombian sworn translator and any corporate name transliterated into Latin characters. The suffix 'S.A.S.' is mandatory after the approved denomination. The name must not coincide with, or phonetically or visually imitate, a name already registered in the same economic sector, and must not imply government sponsorship or a regulated financial activity.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: No statutory extension is available; if the 30-day clearance expires, the applicant must file a new name-availability request and pay the applicable fee again. Upon name rejection, the applicant may file an administrative reconsideration petition (recurso de reposición) with the Cámara de Comercio within ten (10) working days of notification; if rejected, a subsidiary appellate petition (recurso de apelación) may be filed with the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) as the RUES registry authority. The SIC decision exhausts administrative remedies, subject to judicial review before the Consejo de Estado.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Accepted where the provider supplies a valid physical street address in the registration municipality, conspicuous signage, and effective service-of-process facilities. Pure mail-forwarding, post-office boxes, or non-street address references are non-compliant with Law 1258 of 2008 and the registration rules of the Cámaras de Comercio. Shared coworking offices are generally accepted for a low-risk logistics services S.A.S.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: approximately 5-10% probability of an unannounced physical inspection within the first 36 months of operations for a non-licensed, low-risk project-cargo logistics entity without red flags. Probability increases materially in the presence of tax audit triggers, UBO filing inconsistencies, anonymous-shareholder structures, or dealings with FATF-listed counterparties.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Articles 1-48) governing Sociedades por Acciones Simplificadas; Código de Comercio de Colombia, Book II (Articles 98-142) as supplemental; Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 de 2015, Book 2, Title 2 (registration procedures).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered-office jurisdiction (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) through the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument) submitted to the Mercantile Registry; Escritura Pública No. ___ before a Notary if real-property or in-kind contributions exceeding 5% of capital are registered.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum capital requirement under Ley 1258/2008; S.A.S. may be incorporated with zero capital. Subscribed capital must be fully paid within two years from incorporation. No escrow/fiducia account is mandated unless contributions in kind are made, in which case the valuation must be recorded in the constituent instrument.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: ACT NO. 1 OF THE FOUNDING SHAREHOLDERS' MEETING OF CARGO HEAVY HAUL S.A.S. The undersigned founders hereby resolve, under Ley 1258 de 2008: FIRST, to subscribe the authorized capital as set forth in the constituent document and to register the share ledger; SECOND, to adopt the statutory address at Carrera 13 #27-01, Bogotá D.C., and to ratify the corporate purpose of OOG heavy project cargo logistics, hauling, and freight-forwarding under ISIC 5229; THIRD, to appoint the General Manager and Alternate Legal Representative granting broad powers to sign contracts, tax returns, and transportation permits; FOURTH, to ratify incorporation expenses and to authorize registration with the Chamber of Commerce.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá / Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) — online portal rues.org.co.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name-search application in the RUES portal for 'Cargo Heavy Haul S.A.S.' requesting a Certificado de Homonimia (name-similarity certificate). The Chamber verifies that no identical registered name exists and issues the certificate, which is valid for 60 calendar days for filing the incorporation.
required_dossiers: Identification document of the requesting founder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is identical or confusingly similar, the founder may re-file with an alternative name or add a distinguishing suffix; a fresh Certificado de Homonimia can be issued within one business day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founders directly (private document) or a Notary (public deed) depending on contribution type.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución (or Escritura Pública) using the Chamber's pre-printed barcode sheet. The instrument must state the corporate name, domicile, corporate purpose, subscribed and paid capital, board/governance rules, legal-representative appointment, and distribution of profits. Each founder signs and fingerprints the document; if a notarial deed is required, funds and deed registration are completed at the Notary.
required_dossiers: Barcode sheet (código de barras) pre-generated via the Chamber portal
Constituent document text (private or public deed)
Proof of address of the registered office (lease or title)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Notary or Chamber raises legal defects, correct the drafting (e.g., capital schedule, purpose clauses) and re-execute; minor formalities are cured by a supplemental document signed by all founders.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Mercantile Registry Registration with the Chamber of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered office (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) via the 'Chamber in Line' virtual window.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the signed constituent document, barcode sheet, and proof of payment of the registration tariff. The Chamber verifies statutory compliance, records the company in the Mercantile Registry, produces the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal, and triggers integration with RUES delegates. Simultaneously, the Chamber seals the required accounting books.
required_dossiers: Signed constituent instrument (private document or public deed)
Certificado de Homonimia (not older than 60 days)
Cédula copies of legal representative and founders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried by the Chamber, submit a corrective response within 10 business days addressing the stated objection; the original filing remains valid until resolution, and a rejected application can be re-filed with the same barcode sheet without additional payment of the homonimia fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax and NIT Registration with DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — online assisted registration at www.dian.gov.co.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) online using the barcode and Chamber certificate. Obtain the Número de Identificación Tributaria (NIT) and select the tax regime (income tax responsible, VAT liable if invoicing, and applicable withholding roles). For time-critical tenders, a provisional NIT can be requested before Chamber registration, then updated after issuance of the existence certificate.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (or provisional constituent document)
Identity document of the legal representative
Utility bill or lease contract for the registered address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects or flags the application, correct the RUT data online or attend a validation visit; discrepancies in the legal representative or address require an amendment form/process before the RUES and re-submission to DIAN.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Formation Obligations (Accounting Ledger Sealing, ARL Registration, Municipal Permits)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio; Administradora de Riesgos Laborales (ARL); local mayor/Curaduría Urbana (use-of-soil).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the Certificado de Existencia to the Chamber to formalize the Libreo de Accionistas and physical accounting books (Diario, Mayor, Inventarios). Register the company as an employer with an ARL (e.g., Seguros Bolívar, Positiva) for occupational risk coverage. If the office or heavy-cargo yard is operated, obtain the municipal Certificado de Uso de Suelo and request the local fire department inspection before commencing storage or hauling activities.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Physical accounting books (Diario, Mayor, Inventarios y Balances)
Shareholder ledger (Libro de Registro de Acciones)
Lease contract or ownership deed of operational headquarter
SG-SST (occupational health and safety) program draft
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the use-of-soil permit is denied, apply for a conditional-use ruling (Condición de Uso) before the Curaduría Urbana or select alternative industrial-zoning premises; ARL registration can be corrected online by adjusting wage classification codes.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Transporte / Superintendencia de Transporte and Registro Único Nacional de Tránsito (RUNT).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Habilitación para Empresa de Transporte de Carga (road freight operating authorization) plus Permiso Especial de Circulación (Tipo C) for overlength/overweight (OOG) convoy movement on the national road network.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA), with local oversight by the regional Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) for yard operations in Bogotá D.C. (CAR-Cundinamarca).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration / Guía Ambiental — low-to-moderate impact. A full EIA (Estudio de Impacto Ambiental) is not mandatory for a limited logistics yard; however, a Diagnóstico Ambiental de Alternativas becomes obligatory if construction exceeds 20,000 m² or the site is located in special protected zones.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater to public sewers must meet Decreto 1076 de 2015 parameters (BOD5 ≤ 200 mg/L, COD ≤ 400 mg/L, TSS ≤ 200 mg/L, pH 6-9) with prior municipal authorization; stationary generators must comply with Resolución 0627 de 2006 (SO2, NOx, PM10 thresholds); heavy-duty fleet must meet Euro IV/VI or national equivalent emission limits; hazardous waste (used oil, batteries, fuel filters) must be managed by licensed gestores under Decreto 4741 de 2005 and manifested per Resolución 1362 de 2007.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety certification (Conformidad de Normas de Seguridad Humana) issued by the Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos covering extinguishers, sprinklers, emergency exits, and signage; structural load inspection and crane-pad calculation for storage racks and heavy lifting; SG-SST system registration through the chosen ARL including worker training, accident prevention plan, and medical surveillance; truck loading/unloading exclusion zones and manual handling controls per Resolución 2400 de 1979.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – Colombian national tax and customs authority; main taxpayer portal: https://www.dian.gov.co; electronic services platform: https://muisca.dian.gov.co
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned S.A.S. must first appoint a legal representative resident in Colombia and register the company with the local Chamber of Commerce (Cámara de Comercio). The representative then applies to DIAN for the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) and requests inclusion in the RUT (Registro Único Tributario). For foreign shareholders, an apostilled and officially translated certificate of incorporation of the parent entity is required. The RUT application may be processed online via Muisca after biometric verification; the NIT is permanent and must be quoted on all invoices, import/export declarations, and tax filings.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Not available. Colombia does not have check-the-box or hybrid mismatch entity elections. An S.A.S. is automatically treated as a Colombian tax resident separate juridical person subject to entity-level corporate income tax, VAT, and CREE. No pass-through status is available. A limited tax consolidation regime exists only for qualifying Colombian business groups and requires strict statutory ownership thresholds and DIAN authorization; it is not a routine election for ordinary S.A.S. project logistics companies.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (IVA – Impuesto sobre las Ventas), administered nationally by DIAN
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No turnover threshold for incorporated entities. An S.A.S. engaged in project cargo logistics must register in the RUT and obtain Responsible de IVA status before issuing invoices or performing taxable operations, regardless of revenue. Natural persons may use simplified regimes up to current UVT thresholds, but corporations are unconditionally subject to general VAT registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica de Venta) through DIAN-authorised software or DIAN web services. Each invoice must be transmitted in XML format to DIAN for real-time validation before delivery to the buyer; approved invoices receive the CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) or CUNE code, QR stamp, and digital validation. Export invoices must use the special export invoice format. DIAN API integration, invoice numbering control, and reporting under the 'Factura Electrónica' and 'RADIAN' document systems are mandatory for all VAT-responsible taxpayers.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods physically exported from Colombia qualify for 0% VAT and the right to refund input VAT, provided the export is evidenced through a DIAN-approved customs export declaration (DEX) and the goods leave Colombian customs territory. Certain offshore services rendered to non-residents and services physically performed abroad may also be zero-rated if the recipient is outside Colombia and the benefit is consumed abroad. The taxpayer must be a registered exporter under the RUT and must file the DEX through the DIAN/VUCE customs system.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DEX / Declaración de Exportación) accepted by DIAN customs system
Commercial export invoice bearing IRU/IVA wording and buyer NIT or foreign tax ID
Original or electronic Bill of Lading, House Bill of Lading, or multimodal transport document evidencing shipment out of Colombia
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by a Colombian authorised foreign-exchange intermediary
Proof of foreign currency repatriation via Colombia's foreign exchange market (market-rate wire or Letter of Credit settlement evidence)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating is strictly audited by DIAN and the National Customs Authority. If documentary or FX repatriation requirements are not met, DIAN will retroactively claw back the 0% rate, assess the full 19% VAT with daily interest, and impose penalties that may range from 100% to 200% of the omitted tax. False export declarations, forged bills of lading, or fictitious export transactions further trigger criminal customs and documentary fraud liability under Colombian Criminal Code and Decree 1165/2019, as well as loss of VAT input credits. Taxpayers must retain the full export evidence bundle for at least five years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Colombia) – the sole monetary and foreign-exchange authority, administering the Mercado Cambiario (official foreign exchange market) under Decree 1735 of 1993, Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83 (as amended) and Resolución Externa 1 of 2018. Enforcement is shared with the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (prudential and SARLAFT supervision) and the DIAN (customs, tax and FX violation penalties).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a managed-float regime under Law 9 of 1991 and Decree 1735 of 1993. Current-account flows (trade in goods, cross-border logistics services, profit remittances) are freely convertible, but every USD or EUR receipt and payment must be flowed through an authorized Intermediario del Mercado Cambiario (IMC); the Colombian Peso is the only legal tender for domestic settlement. Capital-account operations are convertible subject to prior registration with Banco de la República (Registro de Inversiones Internacionales) and mandatory Declaración de Cambio filings. Dividends and profits of the S.A.S. may be remitted abroad without separate FX authorization, provided the applicable 7.5% non-resident dividend withholding is satisfied. Practical hurdle for OOG project-cargo treasury: all hard-currency liquidity must enter and exit through the IMC banking circuit; offshore clearing or non-IMC digital wallets used as primary rails would violate the canalización obligation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For service exports (including out-of-gauge heavy-haul logistics), 100% of the proceeds must be channeled through the Mercado Cambiario within six (6) months from completion of the underlying service, per Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83. Mandatory surrender ratio is 100%: each USD/EUR receipt must either be sold to an IMC into COP or be credited to a Banco de la República-registered USD Compensation Account (Cuenta de Compensación); no partial foreign-retention or offshore holding is permitted. Advance payments and pre-milestone deposits are channeled immediately upon receipt. Non-compliance triggers DIAN penalty proceedings, loss of export-tax incentives, blockage of subsequent FX registrations, and enhanced SARLAFT review by the bank.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Capital Escrow Account (Cuenta de Inversión) + Operational Account (COP Current and USD Compensation)
Capital Escrow Account + Operational Account (COP/USD, Milestone Wire and LC desk)
Capital Escrow Account + Operational Account (COP Current plus USD Compensation)
Operational Account (COP+USD) for Trade, Treasury and Hedging
Operational Account with FX Derivatives and NDF Trading Line
Operational Account (COP+USD) supporting Supplier Milestone Wires

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW as primary treasury rail; MEDIUM only as ancillary collection wallet. Legal constraints: offshore non-bank electronic money institutions (Wise, Payoneer, Airwallex, DLocal) are not authorized Intermediarios del Mercado Cambiario (IMC) and cannot receive or disburse OOG logistics trade proceeds without breaching the mandatory canalización rules of Decree 1735/1993. Permitted scope is limited to (a) incidental receipts of small deposits from foreign sub-contractors, (b) local peso e-wallet services through Colombian SEDPES licensees (Ley 1735 de 2014), and (c) intra-group disbursements that never enter the Colombian FX market; all USD otherwise received abroad must still be repatriated through the designated Colombian IMC account within six months.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandate: the legal representative and all authorized signatories of the S.A.S. must pass the KYC/SARLAFT interview under Circular Básica Jurídica (Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia, Título IV, Capítulo IV). In practice, Tier-1 Colombian banks require at least one physical appearance of the appointed legal representative at the principal branch to sign the account agreement (Contrato de Cuenta) and complete biometric capture; foreign directors may be onboarded under an apostilled and notarized power of attorney, filed with the Cámara de Comercio, provided the local legal representative attends in person. Full remote opening of a corporate USD operational account is generally unavailable; a biometric video-call can supplement, but not replace, the physical interview.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity: foreign parent holds 100% of the S.A.S. and the chain of title passes through an offshore intermediate holding entity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized Beneficial Ownership Declaration (each UBO >5%) in line with UIAF standards, group organizational chart, certified passports/NIT of final shareholders, apostilled parent-board resolution, and a Cámara de Comercio certificate issued within 30 days.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and watch-list hits on OOG heavy-haul corridors (OFAC, UN, EU, UK HMT, DIAN consolidated lists; cargo destined to or transiting sensitive jurisdictions).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Counterparty sanctions-screening certificate, full contractual chain with cargo end-use attestation, dual-use export-control classification, signed International Sanctions Undertaking, and independent surveyor certificate (SGS/Bureau Veritas) describing the out-of-gauge unit and haul route.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Low effective tax footprint: bank reputational-risk filter flags thin capitalization, zero or marginal income-tax payment in the first two fiscal years.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: DIAN Paz y Salvo tax clearance certificate, audited Colombian GAAP financial statements (Estados Financieros certificados y dictaminados), complete transfer-pricing file for cross-border services, and evidence of compliance with the thin-capitalization rule of Article 118-1 E.T.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: FX-channeling red flags: SWIFT flows arriving from or leaving to non-approved EMI circuits or jurisdictions inconsistent with the declared Mercado Cambiario operations.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed Declaración de Cambio Formulario No. 4 for foreign investment and Formulario No. 3 for services, certified canalización codes, the underlying OOG logistics MSA and purchase orders with commercial invoices, and a beneficiary list matched to NAICS 488510 / ISIC 5229 documentation.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: (1) Pre-register the foreign equity contribution in the Registro de Inversiones Internacionales of Banco de la República through the chosen IMC using Formulario No. 4 (Declaración de Cambio de Inversiones Internacionales); (2) instruct the foreign parent to send a SWIFT MT103 with exact beneficiary corporate name and NIT, using the IMC's USD correspondent account, quoting in Field 70: 'APORTE DE CAPITAL – REGISTRO INVERSION INTERNACIONAL No. [—]' and using 'Charge OUR' to ensure gross proceeds are credited; (3) execute the exchange declaration on the same value date and obtain the Constancia de Canalización from the IMC; (4) retain the Constancia and the investment-register certificate for future dividend remittances and DIAN audits. Registration must be completed before or immediately after the wire; USD must be converted to COP on the transaction date or placed into an authorized USD Compensation Account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails: (1) SWIFT MT103 for milestone vendor payments and subcontracted logistics disbursements, referencing Invoice/P.O. in Field 70 and the applicable Colombian canalización concept code; USD outflows must be effected exclusively through the IMC account circuit. (2) Commercial Letter of Credit under UCP600 via MT700, issued by the local Tier-1 bank for OOG project procurement, advised through the correspondent's USD nostro and settled against transport documents (Bill of Lading, OOG certificate, packing list, CMR). (3) Standby Letters of Credit under URDG 758 for bid/performance bonds on heavy-haul tenders. (4) COP-denominated local supplier payments clear through ACH Colombia and the Banco de la República CUD (Cuenta Única de Depósito) system, with final cross-border cover through CHIPS/Fedwire or SWIFT MT202 Cover via the correspondent network.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/COP Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDF) – domestic or offshore via licensed market makers
Deliverable USD/COP Forwards contracted with Colombian IMC banks
Cross-Currency Swaps (USD/COP, EUR/USD) matched to project cash-flow exposures
USD/COP Currency Options (calls and puts) for contingent milestone exposure
FX plain-vanilla swaps for short-term liquidity rebalancing across compensation accounts
All derivatives require a documented underlying commercial or financial exposure to satisfy Superintendencia Financiera cobertura rules.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil (Annual Commercial Registry Renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce) under supervision of Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 March for companies in existence on 31 December of the preceding year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Misalignment of renewal status triggers penalties up to 1% of registered commercial assets, default interest, a zero-filing status, and potential administrative strike-off of the registration after persistent failure to renew

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración de Renta (Annual Corporate Income Tax Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in mid-April based on the last two digits of the company NIT; expiry is the 9th or 11th banking day cycle prescribed by DIAN
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fine up to 5% of the tax payable subject to minimum monetary limits, default interest, and inaccuracies exposed to further sanction under the Colombian Tax Code

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in February or March as prescribed by DIAN resolution; typically by 9 May for fiscal year ended 31 December
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monetary fines per data record not filed, opportunity cost interest, and diminished tax compliance rating with higher future inspection probability

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUB) Annual Update/Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by the same income-tax-return deadline schedule for the fiscal period; material changes require prompt updating within 30 calendar days after occurrence
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative penalty up to approx. USD 11,000 (or the level set by DIAN), inability to certify tax residence, and elevated anti-money-laundering/beneficial-ownership non-compliance risk

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent statutory audit (Revisor Fiscal) is required if the company exceeds any of the following: total assets above 5,000 times the current legal monthly minimum wage (approx. COP 6,500 million for 2024), gross revenues above 3,000 times such minimum wage (approx. COP 3,900 million), or more than 50 employees; public-interest companies and certain regulated sectors also require a Revisor Fiscal regardless of size
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Full IFRS (NIF) as incorporated in Colombia for Group 1 companies; Simplified IFRS for SMEs (Grupo 2) may apply if the entity meets the size thresholds; books must be maintained in Spanish and pesos

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The legal representative and the accountant must validate and confirm the ultimate beneficial ownership structure each fiscal year in the RUB portal of DIAN, specifically identifying any shareholding transfers or changes in control; changes must be reported within 30 calendar days of the event and confirmed as part of the annual tax-filing cycle

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 300 – USD 700 per year for registered office and local corporate agent services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000 – USD 5,500 per year for a certified independent audit of a mid-size logistics company

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory rate is 35% for S.A.S. entities. Preferential deductions include a 25% additional deduction for investments in science, technology, and innovation; a 50% deduction for environmental control investments; and a reduced 20% corporate rate is available to qualifying Free Trade Zone entities.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 110 – Declaración de Renta y Complementarios para Personas Jurídicas, filed electronically via DIAN MUISCA (Modelo Único de Ingresos, Servicios y Trámites Electrónicos) at www.dian.gov.co
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual return (with mandatory quarterly advance payments of the current fiscal year)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Statutory deadlines are set annually by DIAN Resolution; for calendar-year taxpayers the commercial return is generally due between 8 April and 19 April of the following year, according to the last two digits of the taxpayer’s NIT.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) – taxpayer identification number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident investors must enter the NIT assigned to the Colombian S.A.S.; if entering as a foreign entity without local branch, no NIT is required except for withholding filings.
Enter ISIC 5229 (cargo handling and logistics); update the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) before filing if the code differs.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenues from all domestic and foreign sources
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include all project-cargo haulage revenue and any source income attributed to the Colombian entity; foreign-source income attributable to the local operation must be disclosed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income after deductions, exempt income and NOL offset
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute taxable income by deducting allowable business costs and applying the 12-year loss-carryforward; non-resident shareholders should retain the computation file for DIAN audit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income tax payable at the 35% statutory rate
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the 35% head-line rate after subtracting NOL offsets; no preferential S.A.S. rate exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Less: advance payments (anticipos) paid in prior fiscal year
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Credit quarterly prepayments already settled; a non-resident parent is not entitled to credit foreign taxes in the Colombian return unless a DTA expressly permits.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Balance due (debit) or balance to be refunded (credit)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any DIAN refund for excess withholding must be claimed via the same Form 110 and supported by Colombian bank certification.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty is 5% of the income tax due per month or fraction of month of delay, capped at 100% of the tax due; no tax due results in a fixed fine from 1 to 25 UVT; late payment interest accrues monthly at 1.5%; false or inconsistent data triggers correction surcharges of 20%–160% and criminal exposure for tax fraud.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% dividend withholding tax for non-resident legal entities distributed from taxed Colombian-source earnings; 20% for non-resident individual shareholders under the 2022 reform; 35% withholding on distributions made from exempt or untaxed profits.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The non-resident beneficial owner must provide the Colombian S.A.S. with a valid Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) and a declaration of beneficial ownership prior to distribution; the payer must retain the TRC and the ownership statement for five years and file the Anexo de Retenciones y Autorretenciones with DIAN; if treaty relief is not applied at source, a refund request must be lodged with DIAN using Form 110 and supporting TRC evidence.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest paid to foreign lenders is statutorily withheld at 15%; royalties and technical-service fees are withheld at 35%; bilateral DTA rates may reduce these to 10%–15% upon TRC submission.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory transfer-pricing documentation (Local File, Master File and anual informativo form) is required when consolidated gross income in the previous fiscal year exceeds 135,000 UVT (COP 6,353,775,000 at the 2024 UVT of COP 47,065) or net assets exceed 60,000 UVT (COP 2,823,900,000), and cross-border transactions with related parties exceed 45,000 UVT (COP 2,117,925,000).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia does not operate a discrete Economic Substance Regulations regime like the Gulf jurisdictions, but the Tax Administration applies a general anti-avoidance doctrine requiring the S.A.S. to demonstrate real and substantive premises, payroll, management, and logistical operations in Colombia; artificial shell invoicing arrangements may be recharacterized and lose the S.A.S. limited-liability shield.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion (Código Penal, Art. 434B; Estatuto Tributario Art. 771-2)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Omitting or underreporting OOG project-cargo revenue, using false supplier invoices, or registering fictitious logistics costs to reduce the 35% corporate income tax base; systematically failing to file Form 110.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil liability: default assessment plus interest and a fine of 100%–150% of the tax evaded. Criminal liability for tax evasion above approximately 5,000 UVT (≈ COP 235 million): imprisonment of 48–108 months.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A director who signs a false return or authorizes the fictitious records may be jointly and severally liable for the tax debt; personal fines, travel bans, seizure of assets, and prison terms may be imposed; the corporate veil will be pierced.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Artificial Shell Company / Abuse of S.A.S. Legal Personality
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Colombian S.A.S. as a paper invoicing vehicle for non-resident project-cargo principals, without bank accounts in Colombia, without a physical office or workforce, and without real board or shareholder decisions; failing to maintain corporate records.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the S.A.S. statute and DIAN general anti-avoidance powers, the transactions may be recharacterized; the entity may lose its limited-liability privilege, the tax base may be adjusted, and penalties of 20%–160% of the additional tax may be levied.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and shadow shareholders may be held personally liable for corporate tax obligations if the company’s separate personality is used fraudulently; they may be disqualified from serving as legal representatives in Colombia and may be barred from holding commercial licenses.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / UBO Reporting Red Flags (Law 526/1999, Decree 1517/2014 and SIC Precepts)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting milestone wire payments or assigned letters of credit from end-customers without completing KYC and UBO (final beneficial owner) identification; structuring payments to avoid documentary traceability; executing transactions with sanctioned entities or family members of PEPs without risk assessment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines imposed by UIAF and SIC may reach 20,000 SMMLV (≈ COP 26 billion), cancellation of the commercial registry registration, and criminal prosecution for laundering of assets (6–15 years imprisonment).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers are personally liable for failures in the AML/SOFIA system and UBO registry obligations; they may suffer personal fines, suspension from managing companies, prohibition from contracting with the State, and criminal sanctions.
